checker.upstream_pr: none: bendlang/bend#1210 (head 45663e0a, the earlier form of this change) was closed unmerged; c55a7f03 (variant B, a smaller rewrite of the same idea) was never submitted upstream
checker.provenance: A fork branch, not a Bend release. Upstream bendlang/bend main at 01875127 (after v2.0.34) plus ONE commit on Giulio2002/bend rigid-memo: c55a7f03 'A copy met after an unfold converts before either copy unfolds' (variant B; +27/-45 lines of bend2/bend.ts against 01875127, plus two tests under tests/check/). The full conversion pass asks the rigid, no-def-unfolds comparison (compare_call) again at the arguments of two calls of one def before unfolding them; a rigid pair found unequal is marked on the cell (Var.u) so no failing walk repeats, a rigid whnf no longer fills a shared cell, and the retry adds no stack frame per level. It replaces the earlier two-commit rigid-subterms pin (45663e0a + aa99b746); 45663e0a was the head of bendlang/bend#1210, closed unmerged. Like the #1075 build pinned before, this checker is trusted as the reviewed diff on top of upstream, not as an upstream release. Built on the ssz server at /srv/ssz-optimization/toolchain-memo-788a6866: bend-src/ is a checkout of c55a7f03; bend2/ and guide/ are copies of its bend2/ and guide/; bin/bend = `bun build --compile bend2/main.ts --outfile ../bin/bend` run in bend-src/. It is a release layout like v2.0.34's: bin/bend reads Base from ../bend2/base.bend.
